The company also provides court-ordered forensic evaluations including competency assessments and immigration evaluations. It accepts Medicaid, TRICARE and most private insurance plans. Revenue is estimated at 10 to 30 million dollars with over 10 office locations across the Midwest.

title: Cykoria
summary: cykoria.pl Cykoria S.A. is a Polish food ingredients manufacturer founded in 1996 in Wąpielsk, specializing in instant chicory, dietary fibers including inulin and oligofructose, vegetable powders and custom food blends. With approximately 300 to 400 employees and revenue estimated at 20 to 40 million euro, it exports to over 40 countries across Europe, Asia, the US, Africa and the Middle East. The company processes chicory roots through its full production cycle from harvesting to extraction and spray drying at its facilities in Wąpielsk and Rypin. It holds ISO 22000, HACCP, BRC, IFS, Halal, Kosher and Organic certifications. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange NewConnect market, it is one of the largest chicory processors in Europe. Its products serve food and beverage, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, bakery and animal feed industries globally.

title: Groupe SERL
summary: groupe-serl.fr Revenue $150 Million Groupe SERL is a French engineering and construction group founded in 1985 in Rennes, Brittany, specializing in civil and industrial construction, MEP systems, facility management and energy solutions across France. With approximately 800 to 1,000 employees and estimated revenue of 120 to 150 million euro, it operates regional offices in Nantes, Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille and Toulouse. Its services span gross construction, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire protection, lift installation and renewable energy including solar and heat pumps. The group also provides full facility management including preventive and corrective maintenance, technical building management and energy optimization. It serves office, industrial, healthcare, education, retail, hotel and logistics sectors. Its motto is Build, Maintain, Innovate, reflecting a full lifecycle approach from construction through long-term operations.

title: Living Well Home Care
summary: livingwellhomecare.com Living Well Home Care is a home health agency founded in 2012 in Pearl City, Hawaii, providing skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy and personal care services across all Hawaiian Islands. With approximately 100 to 200 employees including registered nurses, therapists and home health aides, it serves elderly and recovering patients who need hospital-level care at home. It is Medicare certified, Medicaid enrolled and TRICARE approved, accepting most major insurance plans. Its specialized programs cover post-surgical recovery, stroke rehabilitation, heart failure management, diabetes care and palliative support. Revenue is estimated at 5 to 15 million dollars with operations spanning Oahu, Maui, Big Island and Kauai. title: Hicrete Products Technology
summary: hicrete.com Hicrete Products & Technology Co., Ltd. is a Thai construction chemicals manufacturer founded around 2010 in Bangkok, producing epoxy and polyurethane floor coatings, waterproofing systems, concrete repair materials, anti-corrosion coatings and specialized building chemicals. With approximately 30 to 80 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it serves industrial, construction, food, pharmaceutical, oil and marine sectors across Thailand and Southeast Asia. Its product range includes self-leveling epoxy floors, food-grade coatings, carbon fiber reinforcement, cementitious waterproofing and marine-grade anti-corrosion systems. It supplies contractors, architects and facility managers in countries including Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam and Myanmar. Its specialized portfolio addresses demanding environments from clean rooms and food processing.

title: Borax Argentina
summary: boraxargentina.com Borax Argentina S.A.I.C. is an Argentine mining and chemical company founded in 1978, operating as a subsidiary of Rio Tinto and producing borate minerals and boric acid from mines in Salta and Jujuy provinces. With approximately 500 to 1,000 employees and estimated revenue of 150 to 300 million dollars, it runs the Tincalayu complex, Argentina's largest borate processing facility, and exports to over 30 countries. Its product range includes borax pentahydrate, boric acid, anhydrous borax and ulexite serving glass, ceramics, agriculture, detergents, metallurgy, pharmaceuticals and nuclear industries. The company is vertically integrated from mining through processing to global export via its own port facilities. As part of Rio Tinto Borates alongside the Boron mine in California, it is a key player in the global borate market. Growing demand from renewable energy, electric vehicles and micronutrient agriculture drives its strategic importance.

title: CCBRT
summary: ccbrt.org CCBRT (Comprehensive Community Based Rehabilitation in Tanzania) is the largest disability hospital in Tanzania, founded in 1994 in Dar es Salaam by the German organization CBM, with over 600 staff and more than 2 million patients served over 30 years. It provides ophthalmology including over 10,000 cataract surgeries, orthopedic rehabilitation, plastic surgery for burns and cleft lip, obstetric fistula repair and community-based disability programs across all 26 Tanzanian regions.
